title: 建站上线包
tagline: 从写页面到部署,一套配齐

editor_note.text: 从「帮我做个页面」到真的有人能打开链接,中间隔的就是这四件:frontend-design 兜住审美,两个 Vercel 最佳实践让 React 代码不跑偏,deploy-to-vercel 负责临门一脚。适合想快速把想法变成可分享链接的人。提醒一句:部署那步需要 Vercel 账号,首次会引导登录;公司内网项目请走你们自己的流程。
editor_note.author: 主理人
editor_note.text_en: Between “make me a page” and someone actually opening a link sit these four: frontend-design holds up the aesthetics, the two Vercel best-practice skills keep the React code on track, deploy-to-vercel delivers the final push. For people who want ideas turned into shareable links fast. One note: the deploy step needs a Vercel account and walks you through login the first time; for company intranet projects, follow your own process.

tagline_en: From writing pages to deploying — one set
